node.title: Heavy-ruling degree-24 seed reaches the partial-relative interfaces
node.closure: support-collapsed extraction and exact lift give the pure-locator, rational-profile, or official two-cover-complexity alternative
node.statement: For the actual degree-24 order-32 packet emitted by the heavy Segre ruling branch, exact common-support cancellation leaves dimension at least three, empty common selected support, and a non-affine tuple of slope degree 24 through 31. On its exact residual supports, support-collapsed homogeneous interpolation gives either a pure-locator certificate, a scalar-locator rational certificate with denominator degree at most 67472 and denominator roots retained, or residual two-cover complexity at least 3(m-c)-(K-c)+3. Every certificate lifts to the original heavy-ruling packet with the same denominator, affine locator scalars, support labels, and first-owned slopes. The complexity branch gains exactly 2c and hence gives chi at least 2299571 on the original supports. No output branch is paid.
